Name: No mead for flowered honey
Author: AsheJack
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Tired of having trouble turning flowered honey into mead via automate mode. Or your all mushrooms are automatically goes to preserve jar and turning into pickled version? Well no worries! this mod gives you options to prevent flowered mead and pickled mushrooms. Wild honey will still turn into mead. 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Download the file "Wild Cellar" from the file section and extract it into stardew valley mod file directory.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Need latest version of SMAPI, Stardew Valley and Content Patcher.

Manifest.Name: Wild Cellar
Manifest.Description: Stops mushrooms from becoming pickles, and stops flower honey from becoming mead. Wild honey can still be kegged.
Manifest.Author: Wild Cellar
